title: Moving Location Pins
summary: To fix any locations on a particular route, you can just drag the pin to the correct location and save it. That will be the new location for that address in the future, across all routes.
body: Step 1: On the map, zoom in to the location of the pin you want to move.  Step 2: Click on the pin until the address information appears, that you would like to move.  Step 3: Move the pin to the desired location. Click “Save.”.
